packageRules.description: Nothing merges by itself, and Renovate's commits are not merged at all: this repository is mirrored to public GitHub, and they carry the organisation's own address. A person makes the update as their own commit, with a raised version and a CHANGELOG.md section when it touches ha-gitops-sync/, and Renovate closes its pull request once main has the update.

The add-on's base image and the image check.yml runs the tests in move together in one pull request, so the tests always run on the Python and Alpine the add-on ships with; it waits for a person (rule above).
